derivation.hash: first 8 bytes of sha256(text), big-endian unsigned
derivation.canon: DOMAIN + json.dumps(parts, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True) - a deterministic domain-separated SERIALISATION, not concatenation, so a separator inside an identifier cannot forge a different tuple

scope_values.experiment: one draw per synthetic experiment, SHARED across fields

derivation.extension_note: The subcondition and scope levels supersede the schema/2 'job' level. They change none of master, family or replicate: master_seed and every family seed below are bit-identical to schema/1. The subcondition level is required because a case declares several distinct synthetic scenarios (4 sigma_psi scenarios for C1/C2/C3, 12 cells for C5, 3 rho for C6, 4 alternatives for C7) which would otherwise silently share random numbers. The scope level is required because randomness scope is a property of the quantity, not of the loop: the Branch-A common-mode error is drawn ONCE per experiment and SHARED across fields, which is what makes it cancel in the P2 ratio and not in P3.
